item.tib: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid kyi rnam 'grel zhes bya ba
item.skt: sam+bud+d+ha b+hA Shi ta pra ti bim+ba lak+Sha Na bi barNa nA ma
item.coloph: yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i sku gzugs kyi tshad kyi rnam 'grel rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po d+harma d+hA ra dang / lo tsA ba yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mang yul gung thang gi rgyal sar bsgyur ba'o/ grub kun mkhyen chos rgyal gyi/ gsung gi 'od zer snang bar brten/ mkhan chen b+ho Ta paN+Di ta/ dam chos 'dzin dag gsung brten nas/ yar lungs grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ gung thang rgyal sar legs par bsgyur
